description.narrative: Silba, Kloop, and YETT are establishing a partnership project to facilitate civil and voters? rights in Zimbabwe, through the mobilisation of youth volunteers to observe the national harmonised elections anticipated to take place in August 2023. Through this project, we will adapt Kloop?s online election observation platform - GigaTurnip - to the Zimbabwean context, and train hundreds of volunteers in using it. We aim to recruit 50 accredited observers and 315 non-stationed observers to rotate in mobile groups, to efficiently monitor inside and outside targeted polling stations. The observers will document electoral misconduct on the inside (ballot stuffing, violation of the secrecy of voting, etc.) and outside (voter bussing, vote buying, voter intimidation, etc). The results of the election mission will be published in real-time with the help of GigaTurnip, available for stakeholders, voters, civil society, and the international community, and disseminated to the public in Zimbabwe with the cooperation of local media networks. Our mission will help make the Zimbabwean authorities accountable for their democratic standards, increasing transparency.
